content.instructions: Nationalities are nouns, so they are capitalised. Most have a male and a female form (add -in for women). After sein there is no article: Ich bin Italienerin. (Ich bin eine Italienerin is possible, but the form without the article is the usual way to state nationality.) With aus, most countries take no article. A few countries do: aus der Schweiz, aus der Türkei, aus den USA.
